BL-1079 — A Cursor identity can be steward-certified for production routing: without register, compliance battery and certify, ModelFactory must not silently route ordinary packs to Cursor
What it solves: BL-712 remaining slice C. Depends on BL-1078. Parent epic BL-712.
Approval context: Minted 2026-08-22 by operator Let's Talk ask for Cursor-as-swarm-seat enabling tickets. This is BL-712 slice C — Model Steward registration and certify. Needs feature-file approval. Depends on the launcher path (BL-1078) so certify has something real to point at.
BL-1079 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1079" (or "reject BL-1079 <reason>") to act.
